features.name: files_created
features.description: Number of file creation events in the window

features.name: files_modified
features.description: Number of file modification events in the window

features.name: files_deleted
features.description: Number of file deletion events in the window

features.name: files_renamed
features.description: Number of file rename/move events in the window

features.name: unique_extensions
features.description: Count of distinct file extensions touched in the window

features.name: unique_directories
features.description: Count of distinct parent directories touched in the window

features.name: extension_change_count
features.description: Count of move events where source extension differs from destination extension

features.name: rename_ratio
features.description: files_renamed divided by total_events in window

features.name: mean_entropy
features.description: Mean Shannon entropy (0.0 to 8.0) of files modified/created in window

features.name: entropy_change
features.description: Mean entropy change delta across modified files in window
